title: English Fluency Shadowing Practice: Mindset & Daily Life

segments.text: Hello everyone, and welcome back to English Fluency Teacher. Today we are going to do an English shadowing practice.
I don't need perfect English to have a meaningful conversation.
Every time I speak aloud, I'm making English easier to access next time.
Shadowing trains my ears and mouth to work together.

segments.speaker: Speaker A
segments.text: What time did you wake up this morning?

segments.speaker: Speaker B
segments.text: I woke up around 7:00, but I stayed in bed for another 10 minutes.
What helps you start the day in a good mood?
Excellent work! Keep listening, keep practicing, and most importantly, keep speaking English.
